name: Python · FastAPI · React

layers.testing: pytest + httpx TestClient (backend), Vitest + React Testing Library (frontend), Playwright (end-to-end)

conventions: Backend layout: app/api (routers), app/services (business logic), app/repositories (data access), app/models (ORM), app/schemas (Pydantic), tests/ mirroring app/.
Frontend layout: src/api (typed client), src/components, src/pages, src/hooks, src/types; one component per file.
Python names: snake_case functions and modules, PascalCase classes, UPPER_CASE constants. TypeScript: camelCase, PascalCase components and types.
Dependency injection through FastAPI Depends; no module-level database sessions.
Configuration through pydantic-settings from environment variables.

name: .NET · ASP.NET Core · React

layers.database: Azure SQL Database, Entity Framework Core 8 with code-first migrations
layers.testing: xUnit + FluentAssertions + WebApplicationFactory (backend), Vitest + React Testing Library (frontend), Playwright (end-to-end)
layers.quality: dotnet format, .NET analyzers with warnings as errors, ESLint + Prettier

conventions: Solution layout: src/<App>.Api, src/<App>.Application (use cases), src/<App>.Domain, src/<App>.Infrastructure; tests/<Project>.Tests per project.
C# names: PascalCase types, methods and properties; camelCase locals and parameters; _camelCase private fields; async methods end in Async.
Dependency injection through the built-in container; options pattern for configuration.
Nullable reference types enabled in every project.

name: Node.js · NestJS · React

layers.testing: Jest + Supertest (backend), Vitest + React Testing Library (frontend), Playwright (end-to-end)
layers.quality: ESLint (typescript-eslint strict) + Prettier, tsc --noEmit in CI

conventions: Backend layout: src/<feature>/ with <feature>.module.ts, .controller.ts, .service.ts, dto/, and <feature>.spec.ts next to the code.
Names: camelCase variables and functions, PascalCase classes and types, kebab-case file names.
Validation with class-validator DTOs on every controller input.

name: Java · Spring Boot · Angular

layers.backend: Java 21, Spring Boot 3 (Web, Validation, Data JPA)
layers.database: PostgreSQL 16, Spring Data JPA, Flyway migrations
layers.testing: JUnit 5 + Mockito + Spring Boot Test (backend), Jasmine/Karma (frontend), Playwright (end-to-end)

conventions: Backend layout: com.<org>.<app>.<feature> packages with controller, service, repository, model and dto sub-packages.
Names: camelCase methods and variables, PascalCase classes, UPPER_SNAKE constants.
Constructor injection only; no field injection.
Configuration through application.yml with environment-variable overrides.
